The Challenge

Promotions are a Double‑Edged Sword

60%

Of promotions fail to generate incremental profit — they simply shift sales or attract discount‑seekers, eroding margins.

40%

Of retailers lack the analytics to measure promotion cannibalization, leading to poorly designed campaigns.

$200B

Estimated annual waste in retail promotions that fail to deliver net positive returns.

Turn Promotions into a Profit Driver

Promotions are a powerful tool for driving sales, clearing inventory, and acquiring customers. But without rigorous analysis, they can also erode margins, cannibalize regular‑price sales, and attract unprofitable customers. Many retailers operate promotions on intuition rather than data, wasting significant marketing spend.

Our Promotion & Discount Performance Analysis service provides a complete view of promotion effectiveness. We measure true incremental revenue — separating promotion‑driven lift from baseline sales. We quantify cannibalization, ensuring you understand how much of the promotion's revenue is incremental versus shifted from other products or channels.

We also assess profitability, considering not just revenue but also margin impact, customer acquisition costs, and long‑term customer value. We help you identify which promotions deliver the best returns and which should be discontinued.

We also provide guidance on promotion timing, duration, type, and channel to maximize effectiveness. Ultimately, we help you build a data‑driven promotion strategy that balances revenue growth with margin protection.

Promotion Performance

Our Approach

Promotion Data Integration & Normalization

We consolidate data from your promotional planning systems, POS, e‑commerce, and loyalty programs. We normalize campaigns — discounts, bundles, free shipping, coupons — into a consistent framework for analysis, regardless of channel or promotion type.

Incremental Revenue & Cannibalization Analysis

We use causal inference techniques to separate the true incremental impact of promotions from baseline sales. We quantify cannibalization — how much of the promotion's lift comes at the expense of other products or regular‑price sales — to ensure promotions drive net growth.

ROI & Profitability Assessment

We calculate the return on investment for each promotion, considering not only revenue but also margin, customer acquisition, and long‑term value. We identify which promotions deliver the best returns and which should be discontinued.

Promotion Timing & Duration Optimization

We analyze the relationship between promotion duration, timing, and performance. We identify optimal campaign lengths and seasonal windows that maximize impact and minimize profitability erosion.

Promotion Type & Channel Effectiveness

We compare the performance of different promotion types — percentage discounts, fixed discounts, BOGO, free shipping — across channels. We identify which formats resonate best with specific customer segments and drive the highest conversion.

Post‑Promotion Customer Behavior Analysis

We track customer behavior after promotions — repeat purchase rate, average order value, and brand engagement. We assess whether promotions attract new loyal customers or just discount‑seekers, informing long‑term strategy.

What We Deliver

Promotion Performance Dashboard

Real‑time view of promotion KPIs — revenue lift, incremental sales, ROI, and margin impact — for all active and historical campaigns.

Cannibalization & Incrementality Report

Detailed assessment of how much promotion revenue is incremental and how much is cannibalized from other products or channels.

Promotion ROI & Profitability Scorecard

Ranked list of promotions by financial return, enabling data‑driven decisions on which campaigns to repeat, modify, or discontinue.

Promotion Type & Channel Effectiveness Report

Comparative analysis of promotion formats and channels, with recommendations for the most effective combinations.

Customer Segment Response Analysis

Understanding of how different customer segments respond to promotions, enabling personalized campaign design.

Post‑Promotion Customer Retention Report

Tracking of customer behavior after promotions — repeat purchase rate, AOV changes, and loyalty impact.

Core Capabilities

Promotion Performance Dashboard

Real‑time tracking of promotion KPIs — revenue lift, profit impact, redemption rates, and ROI — with drill‑down to individual campaigns.

Cannibalization & Incrementality Analysis

Quantify the true incremental revenue driven by promotions and identify any negative impact on regular‑price sales.

Profit & Margin Impact Assessment

Measure the effect of promotions on gross margin and profitability, ensuring that discounts don't erode overall financial health.

Promotion Type & Channel Attribution

Compare performance of different promotion formats and distribution channels to identify the most effective combinations.

Timing & Duration Analysis

Discover optimal promotion timing and duration for each product category and customer segment.

Customer Segment Performance

Analyze promotion response by customer segment (new vs. existing, high‑value vs. low‑value) to tailor future campaigns.
